name: Approaches in Science and Technology Studies
description: The course is an advanced introduction to the interdiscipline of science and technology studies. It covers various topics, including the history and prehistory of the interdiscipline, including the emergence of an autonomous STS in South Asia, methodologies in science and technology studies, social approaches to understand scientific method, ideas about autonomy in the production of knowledge, expert and lay public participation in production of knowledge, social and other philosophical approaches to technological knowledge, including social approaches in scientific and technical realities, and actor network theory, feminist approaches in science and epistemology. This is a reading intensive course.
